Calibre 9.15 is out! 

The biggest addition is “Create your own adventure,” an optional AI feature that lets you create interactive stories. The AI manages the story world and reacts to your choices. It is not enabled by default.

Besides that, the E-book viewer gets improvements, including better highlight controls, saved window sizes, notes on highlights, and fixes for Read Aloud.

Meanwhile, the Edit book tool has received several bug fixes.
